name: Spore Eruption
body:
School: conjuration (creation); Level fungomancer 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a handful of different mushroom spores)

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Area 40-ft.-radius burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex partial and Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create an explosive burst of harmful spores. All creatures in the area take 1d6 points of damage per caster level (maximum 15d6) and are sickened for 1d4 rounds. A successful Reflex save halves the damage, and a successful Fortitude save negates the sickened condition. Plant creatures take half damage and are not sickened.
